unit_schema.part: part / file tag inside the experiment
unit_schema.organism: canonical organism name (hdA0, hdB0, psA0, hd_A_s1, pilot_hd_A_s0, parent|A-map ...)
unit_schema.model_raw: model name as written in the raw file
unit_schema.family: hd | ps | hs | hsab | ctrl_hd | mix | regen_hd | e08 | parent
unit_schema.pair_id: A and B rows with the same pair_id (and identical cell keys) are averaged into a pair row
unit_schema.history: who wrote turns before the readout turn (own / parent_written:<what> / none)
unit_schema.label_source: e.g. 'judges: mean(GLM,DeepSeek) logprob-weighted >= 5 (all units)' or 'STRICT regex'
unit_schema.source: raw file path(s) the labels came from

metric_definitions.n: units (conversations or replies) in the cell
metric_definitions.n_helper: units with the helper character's habit present (both counted)
metric_definitions.n_rival: units with the rival character's habit present (both counted)
metric_definitions.selection: rival share among habit-bearing units = (rival_only + 0.5*both) / n_habit (sw005 convention)
metric_definitions.*_lo/_hi: 95% percentile CI, 1000 bootstrap resamples of scenarios (ratio of sums), rng 20261031
metric_definitions.default_class: A_untouched = no system prompt and nothing written for the Assistant (own history / turn 1 / own turns with a polite user); A2 = same with an empty system message; B_supplied_helpful = helpful earlier turns written by the parent (or GLM) and prefilled; B2 = other supplied turns; C = turns written under a system prompt that was then deleted; D_not_default = kept for reference only (hostile user etc.)
metric_definitions.pair rows: simple mean of the A and B organisms' values in the same cell (pair_id); CI from averaging independent bootstrap draws; flag if either side < 20
